hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The uniqueness array contains the distinct element counts for all n * (n + 1) // 2 subarrays. We need the median value.

hints.title: Monotonicity
hints.text: The number of subarrays with at most k distinct elements is monotonically non-decreasing with respect to k.

hints.title: Window Counting
hints.text: Binary search on k from 1 to n. Use a sliding window with frequency dictionary to count subarrays with at most k distinct values and compare against the median rank.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search over range [1, n] with O(n) sliding window checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all O(n^2) subarrays exceeds both memory and time limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transform median finding over all subarrays into binary search with sliding window verification.
